macros.name: KKcodeE
macros.doc: \KKcodeS and \KKcodeE provide an environment-like output which is very close to the lstlisting.

macros.name: KKcodeS
macros.doc: \KKcodeS and \KKcodeE provide an environment-like output which is very close to the lstlisting.

macros.name: KKvClearMapTeX
macros.doc: \KKvClearMapTeX{<char>} removes the TeX-command mapping for a character and restores the default behaviour (for space: reverts to non-breaking space).

macros.name: KKverb
macros.doc: The KKluaverb is a LaTeX package which provides a Lua-enhanced \verb command, \KKverb.

macros.name: KKvOpChange
macros.doc: \KKvOpChange can change font and color of the output of \KKverb.

macros.name: KKvSetCodeEscape
macros.doc: The escape character can be changed by \KKvSetCodeEscape{<character>}.

macros.name: KKvSetMap
macros.doc: \KKvSetMap replaces a character with another character.
